subject: Tree Canopy Protection and Mitigation Ordinances
overview: The committee discussed a multi-part tree ordinance aimed at preserving the city canopy through updated regulations for public trees, private property, and the creation of a Tree Committee. Members moved to refine the public tree language to align with state law and requested a revised draft for private tree regulations based on a zoning mitigation model.

items.title: Public Tree Preservation and Protection
items.summary: The committee discussed establishing a tree fund and updating local definitions to align with state forestry laws. Motions were approved to remove the 30-day stump removal requirement for city work and to merge procedural subsections to ensure consistency with MGL Chapter 87.

items.title: Private Tree Regulations and Zoning Model
items.summary: Building Commissioner Bill Forte recommended regulating private tree removal via the zoning ordinance by implementing a mitigation chart for construction projects instead of general prohibitions. The committee approved a motion requesting that the Building Commissioner draft a new version of the private tree ordinance reflecting this zoning and permit-based approach.

items.title: Establishment of a Tree Committee
items.summary: Councilors and staff discussed whether the proposed committee should have regulatory authority or serve in an advisory capacity to avoid usurping the Tree Warden's statutory powers. A motion was approved requesting written comments from the DPW Commissioner and Tree Warden to clarify the committee's advisory duties and jurisdictional boundaries.
